title: Lifts of unramified twists and local-global principles
summary: We prove that two-step nilpotent $p$-extensions of rational global function fields of characteristic $p$ satisfy a quantitative local-global principle when they are counted according to their largest upper ramification break ("last jump"). We had previously shown this only for $p\neq2$. Compared to our previous proof, this proof is also more self-contained, and may apply to heights other than the last jump.
